newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - USAir downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - USAir downgraded to hold.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities analyst Susan Donofrio said in a research note that she downgraded USAir to hold from buy.
-- Shares were up 3/8 to 24-1/8 in afternoon NYSE trade.

-- "Airbus (Industrie's) announcement that it is withdrawing its guarantee of a delivery spot of a total of 57 aircraft in 1998 and 1999 not only puts a wrench into management and labor negotiations but also is likely to keep costs at USAir at a higher level," the analyst wrote.
-- "While USAir may look compelling on a valuation basis, we believe that the stock is likely to remain stagnant as a result of no imminent labor deal," she said.
